Container.Name: backinframe
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0 (2026-11-15) - First release: web app with push notifications, ntfy, e-mail, Telegram, Signal, Matrix and Discord. - Hearts on memories, a hearts overview and a year review in January. - Photos from Immich and Nextcloud, optional two-step verification on the admin page.
Container.Overview: Back in Frame sends a photo or video from a folder of your choice to your phone now and then, as a notification - so the photos you took get seen again. Recipients use the Back in Frame web app (needs an https address, e.g. via your reverse proxy) or the free ntfy app. Photos from "this day, years ago" get priority; each recipient chooses their own rhythm and can tap More / Less / Pause under every photo. Works through the public ntfy.sh without open ports, or with your own ntfy server for full privacy. Mount your photo share read-only on /media.

Config.Name: Admin page
Config.Description: Web page to add recipients and change settings.

Config.Name: Web app
Config.Description: Recipient web app. Only this port goes behind your reverse proxy; the admin page stays at home.

Config.Name: Web app address
Config.Description: The https address of the web app, e.g. https://memories.example.com. Empty = ntfy only.

Config.Name: Photos
Config.Description: Folder with the photos and videos to send (read-only). Subfolders per trip become the notification title.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database. Keep this: it holds the recipients and their topics.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for the time windows.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Language of the admin page, and of recipients who have no language of their own.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional password for the admin page. With it you can turn on two-step verification under Security.

Config.Name: ntfy server
Config.Description: ntfy server to publish to. Keep https://ntfy.sh for the easy setup.

Config.Name: ntfy public URL
Config.Description: Only for your own ntfy server: the HTTPS address phones use to reach it.

Config.Name: ntfy token
Config.Description: Access token if your ntfy server requires login.

Config.Name: Send videos
Config.Description: Also send videos.

Config.Name: Max video size (MB)
Config.Description: Upper limit for videos; the ntfy server limit also applies.

Config.Name: SMTP server (e-mail channel)
Config.Description: Turns on photos by e-mail. Also set the sender.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 with starttls, 465 with ssl.

Config.Name: E-mail sender
Config.Description: e.g. Back in Frame <photos@example.org>

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: From @BotFather. Turns on Telegram.

Config.Name: Signal API URL
Config.Description: signal-cli-rest-api, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8095. Turns on Signal.

Config.Name: Signal number
Config.Description: The number registered in signal-cli, +31…

Config.Name: Matrix homeserver
Config.Description: e.g. https://matrix.example.org. Turns on Matrix.

Config.Name: Matrix access token
Config.Description: Of the bot account.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283. Takes albums from Immich (admin guide, section 7).

Config.Name: Immich API key
Config.Description: Permissions: album.read, asset.read, asset.view, asset.download

Config.Name: Immich albums
Config.Description: Album names, comma-separated. Empty = every album.

Config.Name: Nextcloud URL
Config.Description: e.g. https://cloud.example.org. Takes a folder from Nextcloud.

Config.Name: Nextcloud user
Config.Description: Nextcloud user name

Config.Name: Nextcloud app password
Config.Description: An app password, not your login password

Config.Name: Nextcloud folder
Config.Description: e.g. Photos/Back in Frame

Config.Name: Hearts
Config.Description: Recipients in the web app can put a heart on a photo; you see which ones on the Hearts page.

Config.Name: Year review
Config.Description: In the first two weeks of January every recipient gets one review of the past year.

Config.Name: Discord
Config.Description: Offer Discord webhooks as a delivery.
